capabilities.name: tag.context.overview
capabilities.use: Nexuses, caller's role, TAG invited, expectation summary.

capabilities.name: tag.work.status
capabilities.use: State and outcome of TAG work by id or listed by pillar.

capabilities.name: tag.expectations.read
capabilities.use: Full expectation list with states and obligors.

capabilities.name: tag.request.ask
capabilities.use: File a confirmed request as an expectation for TAG's side.

inputs.name: organization, acting principal, nexus, correlation id
expectations and their states
inputs.source: tag.expectations.read, or the tag.context.overview summary until it is bound

inputs.name: task to add: what, for whom, by when
inputs.source: the person's request, confirmed before filing

outputs.name: status summary
outputs.description: Items grouped by view with identifiers, states as reported, obligors, due dates.

outputs.name: filed request
outputs.description: Confirmed request text and the returned identifier.

conditions: The person confirms the exact request text before tag.request.ask is called.
Requests that commit the organization to a third party, or name another party as obligor, are confirmed by someone with authority to make that commitment.
Deciding an obligation is a separate authorized operation for the owning side, outside this skill.
